# 禅道 Bug 6931 检查中修改评价等级
苏住房防汛 C 端移动查询 H5 缺陷：街镇/区县/市级检查中修改评价等级后题目未按新等级重载，2026-11-24 hop3 定位为后端未透传 grade 入参。

## 现象
- 「01 综合能力」的「评价等级（可修改）」可选 5 个市标等级，切换有确认弹窗，但改等级后题目内容不变（hop2 实机确认入口可见）。
- 前端 `/check/start` 请求 body 已正确携带 `gradeComprehensiveLevel`="1"/"2" 及另四类等级（req 22308.143/144 逐字段核对）。

## 根因（2026-11-24 实证）
- 三次请求返回的五类 evalLevel 恒为 3/3/4/2/5，综合能力 contentId 恒为 …0031,0032,0033，与请求等级无关，说明部署版后端忽略 grade。
- `H5StdEvalCheckServiceImpl.start()` 构造 `StdEvalCheckInitDto` 时只 set complexId + checkType，未拷贝 grade，`initItems()` 遂回落备案等级；`H5CheckStartDto` 原本无 grade 字段。
- `GET /checkRecord/initItems` 实测支持 grade：g=1→…0001-3、g=2→…0016-8、g=3→…0031-3，证明题目本身可按等级取回。

## 修复与验证状态
- 用户直接授权改后端后拉取最新代码（分支 `develop/v2.6.2-suzhufang-dev`），改 2 文件：`H5CheckStartDto` 加 5 个 grade 字段、`start()` 透传 grade（diff 21 行新增、无删除）。
- 本地补齐缺失依赖（zhi2-property-api、common-framework-api 等）后 `mvn compile` EXIT=0 通过。
- 阻塞项：nginx 8095 上游是远程测试服 192.168.1.31，本地改动不生效，须先部署后端才能实机验证。
- 代码未提交、禅道未回写（验证门未过）；交接见 HANDOFF-CHAIN-bug6931 hop3 文档。

# HANDOFF-CHAIN-bug6931-检查中修改评价等级-hop3
九节链式交接文档，记录 2026-11-24 苏住房防汛 C 端禅道 6931「检查中修改评价等级」在 hop3 的根因定位、后端修复与部署阻塞状态。

## 位置与作用
- 路径 D:/plan/苏住房防汛C端/HANDOFF-CHAIN-bug6931-检查中修改评价等级-hop3-20261124-1526.md。
- 会话量达 1.00M 触发 P0 硬交接后写入；共 9 节，第 4 节列未完成项、第 5 节为链元信息、第 9 节写下一跳目标。
- hop4 已排程 2026-11-24 15:27:46 自动开新会话接续：部署 → 实机验证 → 用户确认 → 提交 + 回写禅道（附图）→ 清理。

## 记录的结论
- 根因在后端：`/check/start` 忽略 grade，`/checkRecord/initItems` 支持按等级取题；`start()` 未把 grade 拷入 `StdEvalCheckInitDto`。
- 已改后端两文件（DTO 加 5 个 grade 字段 + start 透传）并在补齐依赖后 `mvn compile` EXIT=0，但未提交。
- 验证门未过：需先部署到远程测试服（nginx 8095 上游 192.168.1.31），禅道未回写。

# zhi2-mobile-query-h5-c
Suzhou Housing flood-control C-end mobile query H5 built with uni-app Vue3; GitLab `suzhufang-fe/zhi2-mobile-query-h5-c`; main branch `dev`; local dir `D:\repository\苏住房防汛C端`.

## Pages & Features
- `home/index.vue` (`.scroll-tabs` + `BottomNav`): 2026-11-04 C-end style feed homepage (carousel/todos/learning corner/news list); 2026-11-14 added skeleton and data mapping (banner uses API title/image, falls back to fixed brand copy when empty; todos use homepage task summary keeping source/date/category tags; list uses C-end APIs), pushed `fix/home-visual-20261114` (`a8f6c97652f4ae242135198bc2e3e335f73b527d`); of the five bottom items only 「我的」 was renamed 「个人中心」.
- `mine/index.vue`: `.user-card` blue gradient, `.menu-card` white, `.mine-body` skeleton; data assembled by `portalData.ts fetchMine`.
- `data/index.vue`: statically injects design DOM `REF_SEC0~REF_SEC5` from `ref-assets.ts` (auto-generated, must not be hand-edited); region chips and metrics were hardcoded, now only unique title labels (region/area/enterprise count) are bound; detail sub-grid and property evaluation remain design-only (backend APIs missing).
- Login: `useFloodStore().login` calls `/v2.0/security/auth/login`, returns `nickName/userName/userId/phone/roles`; captcha placeholder still 「请输入图形验证码」.
- 2026-11-16 requirement: tapping 汛前/汛中/汛后 opens a popup to pick 「物业管理区域」 and 「预警事项」, the list header shows the selection, popup UI modeled on the supplied HTML.
- `project-check/form/index.vue`: project check form page; 2026-11-24 ZenTao bug 6931 uncommented the evaluation-grade picker (3 files uncommitted) so a local draft reloads questions by the new grade and `startCheck` carries grade params; real-machine check on 2026-11-24 confirmed the entry is visible (01 综合能力 shows 「评价等级（可修改）」 with five 市标 options and a switch confirmation dialog) but after changing the grade the deployed backend still returned 「市标三级」 and the question contentId set stayed identical — core function failed.

## Build & APIs
- Each task gets a git worktree (no `node_modules`, junction to main repo to avoid copying), merged back to `dev` and cleaned after verification; background build exits 0 producing `dist`; before commit run `worktree-snapshot` to check isolation and `submodule-commit` to commit/push.
- Default `bun run build demo` (`usePortalApi()` false uses seed data); remote `uni build -m test` uses `.env.test`; bun as package manager, no ESLint CLI; Vitest covers `tests/**/*.test.ts`, remote mock request locks bizState→status mapping.
- Homepage empty data: `usePortalApi()` requests lists only when API base is non-empty and a token exists; preview build sets `VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api` and intercepts responses; deployment must set `VITE_API_BASE_URL` or `VITE_AUTH_BASE_URL`; learning/news come from fixtures and field mapping was not verified against real API responses.
- request util: `raw:true` returns `{code,msg,data}` envelope unwrapped by the caller, default unwraps data; `portal.ts detail()` unwraps the envelope; `GET /v2.0/system/region/list(parentCode=320500)` needs no login, returns `JsonResult<List<SysRegionVo>>` (items `{regionName,regionCode,level,parentCode}`); 2026-11-11 added `getKeyData/getBenefitData/getRepairData/getSunshineOverview/getRegionList` with the same unwrap pattern.
- 2026-11-24 the 求援工单 detail page was traced to an unwrapped `raw:true` envelope plus mismatched logs/region field names; the supplementary fix plan was reviewed and approved (see 「求援工单详情」).
